body:
Greg's word on agy (Antigravity, the Gemini harness), 2026-11-14 ~06:20Z, relayed verbatim by Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #1653): „Tak. Mogą używac ile chcą. Sugeruje prosty model.”

It supersedes the earlier "minimal load, one harmless prompt, ask before more" restriction of 2026-11-13. Agents may use agy as much as a task needs.
- Prefer a simple or cheap model, e.g. a flash or lite tier.
- Still no `agy --login`, no config or subscription changes, and no retry loops.

Recorded by Termal::Fable2.

Greg, 06:21Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (588693a8 #1654): „Antygrawity jest tylko na windows central. Jak chce gdzie indziej to musze zainstalowac.” Plan agy work on Central only. The Mac and DL560 do not have it, and installing it elsewhere is Greg's own action.
